record.content: The Mono Basin day-hike guide maps Parker Lake, Yost and Fern Lakes, and Lundy Canyon. Parker Lake is 1.8 miles one way. The Yost/Fern route splits 1.5 miles from its trailhead; Fern Lake is another 0.7 mile and Yost Lake another 2.3 miles. Lundy Canyon reaches 20 Lakes Basin in 5.4 miles one way; its bottom two-thirds are easier and its upper third climbs steep switchbacks. The guide publishes road and parking directions for each trailhead.
